name: Dialogue
purpose: Two people talking: each line appears as it's spoken, in that person's voice.
use_when: modeling how a conversation should sound
avoid_when: a single narrator explaining (use another scene)

chat.desc: Speakers at the top, lines as alternating bubbles

focus.desc: One line at a time, large, under the speaker's name

lines.text: What's one moment this month when you felt at your best?
Leading the customer demo. They really listened.
So what skill was behind that?
Telling a clear story with data.
